thread:
Daphne: Heads up — publish for release v1.12.0 scheduled for 09:00 UTC is failing in us-east-1. Deploy bot shows signing step timeout and skipped the push. Anyone on infra?

DeployBot: publish-job 2026-03-20-09:00 FAILED (region=us-east-1): signing service timeout (504). Push skipped for us-east-1. Other regions: eu-west-1 OK, ap-southeast-1 OK. Logs: /builds/ci/3421/publish.log

Ben: looking at the CI logs now, saw this in the signer stage:
```
[2026-03-20T09:00:02Z] POST https://signer.internal.redwood/sign -> 504 Gateway Timeout
[2026-03-20T09:00:02Z] ERROR: signer timed out after 30s
```

Carlos: I can see a short spike of 5xx from signer in CloudWatch starting 08:58. Also noticed increased error rate from KMS in the same window. No planned NAT or egress changes from infra in the last 24h that I can find.

Alice: Compliance note — images must be signed before they hit prod repos for audit. We can't push unsigned images to the canonical prod repo. Any workaround needs an auditable trail.

Daphne: We have a change window that ends at 09:30 for the customer rollout. Options: (A) pause rollout and wait for signer recovery, (B) replicate the eu-west image into us-east as a temporary stand-in (with explicit note in release notes about unsigned proxy), (C) manual sign via backup signer endpoint if available, (D) rollback the scheduled rollout. Thoughts?

Jessica: QA needs something to run the smoke tests. If we can replicate eu-west->us-east and run smoke, that's acceptable short-term, but we need to ensure the digest and provenance are tracked so we can replace with a signed image later.

Ben: We can do a cross-region pull/push to create a stand-in image quickly. Example commands (manual):
```
# from a bastion with ecr access
aws ecr get-login-password --region eu-west-1 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin xxxxx.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com
docker pull xxxxx.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/redwood/app:v1.12.0
docker tag xxxxx.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/redwood/app:v1.12.0 xxxxx.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/redwood/app:v1.12.0-standin
aws ecr get-login-password --region us-east-1 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin xxxxx.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
docker push xxxxx.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/redwood/app:v1.12.0-standin
```

DeployBot: FYI automated rollout rules will block images without a signature. There is an enterprise override `--force-unverified` but that's gated and leaves audit flags. Use only if leadership approves.

Carlos: I can spin up a temporary proxy-signer that hits the backup KMS endpoint and attempt a manual sign, but that takes ~10-15m and we need keys access. If we can't restore signer, replication is fastest.

Daphne: Decision: Pause the automated rollout for us-east and create a stand-in replica in us-east tagged `v1.12.0-standin`. QA will run smoke against the stand-in. We'll update the release notes with the non-signed stand-in digest and a follow-up action to replace with a properly signed image once signer is healthy (target replacement by 12:00 UTC). If signer isn't fixed by 12:00 UTC we will roll back to previous stable image. I'll open CHG-4521 and notify customers.

Ben: I'll create the stand-in now and post the pushed digest here.

Jessica: Running quick smoke once Ben posts the digest.

InfraBot: CHG-4521 created by Daphne. Linked: incident-7819 (signer degraded). Notifying oncall.

Carlos: I'll keep digging into the signer backend and KMS error rates — will post updates.

Daphne: Thanks all. Keep updates in this thread. Remember to annotate the release notes with the stand-in tag and the justification for audit trace. :spiral_note_pad:
